project_type: Monorepo - FastAPI backend + React frontend (Vite/SSR) + Cloudflare Workers
test_command: pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit test (frontend), ruff check apps/backend/app/ (backend lint)
verification_instructions: 1. Run ruff check apps/backend/app/ - should pass with 0 errors. 2. Run pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit test - all tests should pass.
key_patterns: Frontend tests use vitest 4.x with jsdom environment. Setup file at apps/frontend/src/test/setup.js. Tests in src/**/*.test.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}. Backend uses ruff for linting.
relevant_files: apps/frontend/src/test/setup.js (jest-dom matcher setup broken with vitest 4.x)
apps/frontend/vitest.config.js (need to exclude edge/worker test files)
directory_structure: apps/backend/ (FastAPI), apps/frontend/ (React + Vite), apps/edge/ (Cloudflare edge worker)
